status: Operator-decided check (27 October 2026) under the owner's delegation "ok continue. Your call on all of these", of planner v13, review v11 and renderer v11 (ADR 0006). Measurement only.
purpose: Check whether God is still drawn as a figure in God-appearance scenes after the subject's canon left the image prompt and plans show only witnesses, the place and plain effects. Four cases repeat the v10 failures; four were never used for tuning.

cases.why: Sinai smoke and fire as Yahweh descends; a figure in 3 of 5 v10 images.
The Lord on a throne, his train filling the temple; a figure in 3 of 5 v10 images.
Ancient of Days with clothing and hair; refused preparation in v10.
Israel between walls of water; a figure in 1 of 5 v10 images.
A sapphire throne with the likeness of a man on it; not used for tuning.

Micaiah tells his vision of Yahweh enthroned with the army of heaven; a speaker and a throne; not used for tuning. Its production section cast has no no-form entry, so the no-form rules cannot apply: it measures a cast gap, reported separately.
The elders see the God of Israel with sapphire pavement under his feet; not used for tuning.
Yahweh stands above the ladder and speaks to Jacob; not used for tuning.

design: Eight cases, each prepared once, cold, in a memory store seeded from a read-only production snapshot. A refused preparation stops that case before any image. Each stored case renders classical, watercolor and icon once each, with the references production would send (Classical and Icon style references; the Watercolor reference is stale against the revised style and is skipped). At most 24 images. Later assemblies must reuse the stored plan with zero text calls.

scoring.method: Images are copied under opaque shuffled names without case or style labels beyond what the image shows. Two independent model scorers inspect every image at full resolution; the operator adjudicates and commits before unblinding. Not human acceptance.
perImage: noFormFigure: any face, body, hair, clothing, silhouette or human-shaped figure for God or another no-form subject (yes/no/na)
edges: all four edges painted to the border (full) or any white/unpainted margin or vignette (margin)
extraFigures: framing or unsupported named figures present (yes/no)
coherence: one instant, coherent poses and object states (yes/no)
scoring.gate: Predeclared before any paid call, over the seven cases whose production section cast has a no-form entry (21 images at most). The no-form fix passes if a figure appears in at most 1 of their rendered images (ADR 0006 launch bar: at most 1 in 20), and in none of the three unseen such cases (Ezekiel 1:26, Exodus 24:10, Genesis 28:13). 1 Kings 22:19 has no no-form cast entry, so it is reported separately as a cast gap. Refused cases are reported separately: a refusal is an availability cost for Watercolor and Icon, not a pass. No outcome authorizes activation.

evaluation.measuredBeforeNote: 20.8550026 measured before this pair, plus the full $0.15 cap of the concurrent v11 fresh text check, reserved conservatively.

knownLimitation: Eight chosen God-appearance cases and one image per style are descriptive only; this does not replace the fixed visual matrix or owner sign-off. Model scorers can miss subtle figures in light or cloud.
